Now. As for taxes you need to talk to an tax pro for your business, but you can defer business taxes through a few different mechanism.

If you incorporate your business, you can set up a pension plan for yourself that you contribute to and write off against business taxes.

There is the Small Self-Administered Scheme (SSAS) and the Self-Invested Personal Pension (SIPP). Talk to your CPA, financial planner or do the research yourself to determine which one is best for you, but it will probably be the SIPP.

Then there is what is known as Business Asset Disposal Relief (BADR) which gives you a reduced capital gains tax rate of 14% (it can vary from year to year) with a lifetime cap of up to £1 million of qualifying gains.
